requirements.Statement: Платформа должна управлять Task как последовательностью авторизованных переходов между неизменяемыми составными контекстами до явного TaskAcceptance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Для каждого conformance-сценария существует непрерывная цепочка context roots и ровно один terminal TaskAcceptance.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-001 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна формировать подписанный составной контекст из scoped компонентов Memory, Master, Task, Execution, Acceptance и Authority.
requirements.FitCriterion: Из всех включённых component digests воспроизводится тот же composite root; изменение одного байта изменяет root.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-002 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна запрещать внешний эффект без отдельного ExecutionPermit для точного ExecutionDispatchSubmission, source dependency set и Dispatch Gate.
requirements.FitCriterion: Во всех negative tests отсутствие/несовпадение любого binding даёт ноль OutboxCommand и ноль effect attempt.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-003 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна сохранять причинную цепочку Context→ExpectedChangePatch→ExpectationPermit→ExpectationGate→OperationalBinding→ExecutionPermit→DispatchGate→Observation→Evidence→AcceptanceDecision.
requirements.FitCriterion: Every one of the 11 gate families has an exact digest-linked signed Submission→CoreResolution→Permit→Patch chain; the representative context and provider continuations also resolve without substitution.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-005 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна поддерживать замену model provider без изменения канонического состояния Task, Memory или Core.
requirements.FitCriterion: Один сценарий продолжается на двух provider adapters с одинаковыми canonical receipts и без потери state.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-006 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Все официальные модули должны развёртываться и обновляться независимо через ASET Protocol.
requirements.FitCriterion: Dependency scan: нет импорта internal domain/storage другого модуля; contract compatibility suite проходит.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-007 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна применять risk tier и обязательный human gate для неделегируемых/high-impact actions.
requirements.FitCriterion: Для R3/R4 сценариев без требуемого approval receipt dispatch отсутствует; accountable owner всегда указан.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-004 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна восстанавливаться после сбоя на любой границе гейта без двойного crossing, повторного Permit и ложного результата внешнего эффекта.
requirements.FitCriterion: Fault injection до/после linearization point сохраняет один crossing_id→один target context; unknown effect остаётся UNKNOWN.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-009 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна регистрировать результаты шагов и траекторий для контекстно сопоставимого статистического анализа.
requirements.FitCriterion: Каждый assessed transition имеет context fingerprint, action class, costs, outcome class и evidence level либо explicit missing status.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-010 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна предоставлять native Task API и compatibility adapters для современных LLM API.
requirements.FitCriterion: Native API покрывает полный lifecycle; compatibility adapter сохраняет provider-compatible basic request/stream behavior в заявленном profile.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-011 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна обеспечивать tenant, workspace, project, task, branch и classification isolation.
requirements.FitCriterion: Cross-scope test suite даёт ноль неразрешённых records/context items/metrics.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-008 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна версионировать schemas, policies, models, requirements, receipts и conformance claims.
requirements.FitCriterion: Every declared primary identity is unique in machine, ADR, requirement, verification, model, diagram, conformance, oracle, document and key registries; conflicting duplicates fail release.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-012 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна объяснять статус задачи, denial, obligations, uncertainty, missing evidence и required human action.
requirements.FitCriterion: В role-based usability tests ≥90% critical prompts интерпретированы без обращения к разработчику.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-013 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна применять purpose, legal basis, jurisdiction, retention, hold и data-subject rights к данным и derived indexes.
requirements.FitCriterion: Privacy test matrix покрывает access/correction/erasure/hold conflicts; policy receipt объясняет результат.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-014 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна поддерживать controlled interventions и измерение эффекта процесса с явным evidence level.
requirements.FitCriterion: Experiment record содержит hypothesis, assignment/rollout, metrics, confounders, result and evidence level.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-015 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна поддерживать on-premises, cloud и hybrid deployments без изменения canonical semantics.
requirements.FitCriterion: Conformance vectors дают одинаковые canonical decisions/outcomes в двух deployment profiles.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-016 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна измерять latency, cost, token/context budget и resource usage по task/transition/inference.
requirements.FitCriterion: 100% inference and transition receipts содержат declared/actual usage либо explicit unavailable marker.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-017 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Нормативная спецификация должна быть независима от существующего кода и проверять реализации conformance suite.
requirements.FitCriterion: Ни одно requirement source не ссылается на код как authority; reference implementation passes published suite.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-018 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа должна объявлять ровно один или несколько поддерживаемых conformance profiles с запретами fallback.
requirements.FitCriterion: Conformance report перечисляет modules, versions, guarantees, forbidden fallbacks and passed suites.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-007 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Платформа не должна признавать Task завершённой без отдельного TaskCompletion Gate, CompletionContract и TaskAcceptance Monade Acceptance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Ни один сценарий без принятого CompletionContract не получает terminal COMPLETED context.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-005 and conceptual baseline.

requirements.Statement: Memory shall accept RawEvent with source ID, event time, receipt time, content reference and provenance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema validation accepts complete events and rejects missing mandatory fields with no state mutation.

requirements.Statement: Memory shall preserve the immutable original content reference separately from normalized representations.
requirements.FitCriterion: Hash/content reference remains stable across normalization and consolidation; derived records reference it.

requirements.Statement: EventIngestion lifecycle shall be RECEIVED→VALIDATED→NORMALIZED→EXTRACTION_QUEUED→EXTRACTED, with REJECTED and QUARANTINED exits.
requirements.FitCriterion: State transition suite rejects every transition not in the published table.

requirements.Statement: CandidateDecision lifecycle shall be PROPOSED→ASSESSED→ACCEPTED|QUARANTINED|REJECTED.
requirements.FitCriterion: No candidate reaches ACCEPTED without a versioned decision receipt.

requirements.Statement: MemoryItem lifecycle shall be ACTIVE with optional transitions to CONSOLIDATED, SUPERSEDED, ARCHIVED or FORGOTTEN.
requirements.FitCriterion: Lifecycle suite shows RawEvent/Candidate states cannot appear on MemoryItem.

requirements.Statement: EpistemicStatus shall be independent from MemoryItem lifecycle and include UNVERIFIED, CORROBORATED, VERIFIED, DISPUTED and REVOKED.
requirements.FitCriterion: The same lifecycle state supports multiple valid epistemic states according to transition table.

requirements.Statement: Memory shall set VERIFIED only after validating an independent Verifier receipt.
requirements.FitCriterion: Forged, missing or wrong-scope receipt never produces VERIFIED.

requirements.Statement: One NormalizedEvent may produce zero or more MemoryCandidates with claim, semantic role, confidence and provenance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Test covers zero/one/many candidates and preserves source references.

requirements.Statement: Memory shall support typed links with direction, validity interval, confidence and provenance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema and graph tests reject undefined link type and cross-scope link.

requirements.Statement: Supersession shall preserve prior MemoryItem and mark the active successor without destructive overwrite.
requirements.FitCriterion: Historical query returns both versions and active query returns only successor.

requirements.Statement: Consolidated representations shall retain complete backreferences to contributing MemoryItems.
requirements.FitCriterion: Every consolidated claim resolves to one or more source items; missing source invalidates representation.

requirements.Statement: Retention, archival and forgetting policy shall apply to original content and every derived index.
requirements.FitCriterion: Erasure/forget test leaves no retrievable prohibited derivative; allowed tombstone matches policy.

requirements.Statement: ContextRequest shall include task, principal, purpose, permitted scope, branch, semantic roles and budget.
requirements.FitCriterion: Missing scope or budget is rejected in managed/strict profile.

requirements.Statement: SituationalFrame shall represent SUBJECT, GOAL, ACTIVE_STATE, ACTIVE_BRANCH, HISTORY, DECISIONS, CONSTRAINTS, REFERENTS and NEXT.
requirements.FitCriterion: Benchmark returns every mandatory role or marks it MISSING/CONFLICTED with provenance.

requirements.Statement: Memory shall return explicit OrientationStatus STABLE, PARTIAL, CONFLICTED or INSUFFICIENT.
requirements.FitCriterion: No insufficient case is returned as STABLE.

requirements.Statement: Context packing shall obey byte, token, item and classification budgets deterministically.
requirements.FitCriterion: For fixed inputs/profile, selected item IDs and budget receipt are repeatable and within all limits.

requirements.Statement: Retrieval pipeline shall separate candidate generation, policy/epistemic filtering, ranking, diversity and packing.
requirements.FitCriterion: Stage receipts show every exclusion reason; prohibited item cannot reappear after ranking.

requirements.Statement: Lexical, vector, graph and hierarchy strategies shall be replaceable derived-index providers.
requirements.FitCriterion: A provider can be disabled without changing canonical records or API semantics.

requirements.Statement: Memory shall accept ContextFeedback about citation/use/outcome contribution without self-promoting epistemic status.
requirements.FitCriterion: Utility updates ranking signals; VERIFIED remains unchanged without Verifier receipt.

requirements.Statement: Ingestion, linking, consolidation and retrieval shall enforce tenant/branch/classification boundaries.
requirements.FitCriterion: Cross-boundary randomized tests return zero leaks and zero invalid links.

requirements.Statement: Core должен работать без runtime-зависимости от бизнес-состояния Memory, Master, Monade и Model Gateway, принимая только protocol artifacts и trusted receipts.
requirements.FitCriterion: Core conformance tests выполняются с заглушками issuer verification и без баз данных других модулей.

requirements.Statement: Core должен выносить CoreResolution только со значением PERMITTED или PROHIBITED; техническая ошибка не создаёт резолюцию PERMITTED.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema допускает ровно два verdict; fuzz/error cases никогда не создают Permit.

requirements.Statement: Core должен выпускать OneShotPermit только как следствие CoreResolution=PERMITTED для точного digest документа и source context dependency set.
requirements.FitCriterion: Permit schema и ledger связывают resolution, submission digest и read/write sets; иной выпуск отклоняется.

requirements.Statement: Core должен быть единственным эмитентом authority-bearing Permit; ни approval, delegation receipt, подпись Master или Monade не являются Permit.
requirements.FitCriterion: Подписи не-Core issuer не проходят проверку поля issuer для Permit.

requirements.Statement: Каждый Permit должен быть связан с одним gate type, gate instance, crossing_id, actor/execution_id и maximum_crossings=1.
requirements.FitCriterion: Property tests не находят способа использовать Permit на другом gate/actor/execution или второй раз.

requirements.Statement: Core должен применять default deny: всё, что не доказано как основание выдачи точного Permit, приводит к PROHIBITED или отсутствию Permit.
requirements.FitCriterion: Incomplete, conflicting, stale, expired-at-issuance, overlong-lifetime and unknown input produces zero Permits.

requirements.Statement: Core должен поддерживать versioned issuance rules, precedence, supersession, revocation и authority epoch с воспроизводимым basis в Resolution.
requirements.FitCriterion: Replay документа на зафиксированном policy snapshot воспроизводит тот же verdict и basis.

requirements.Statement: Core должен проверять требуемые human approval receipts как основания выдачи, не превращаясь в workflow engine.
requirements.FitCriterion: При отсутствии receipt — PROHIBITED; после нового документа с receipt возможна новая независимая резолюция.

requirements.Statement: Core должен применять purpose, legal basis, jurisdiction, classification, retention и hold как условия выдачи конкретного Permit.
requirements.FitCriterion: Policy matrix tests покрывают все комбинации и default deny.

requirements.Statement: Core GateKernel должен атомарно создать patch set, новые context components/root, обновить scoped HEADs, consume Permit и создать GateCrossingReceipt.
requirements.FitCriterion: Crash/fault tests наблюдают только before-state или complete after-state, без частичных комбинаций.

requirements.Statement: Один crossing_id должен иметь не более одного линейного результата, который безопасно возвращается при повторном запросе.
requirements.FitCriterion: 100 параллельных одинаковых запросов создают один receipt и один target root.

requirements.Statement: Permit должен становиться неприменимым при изменении любого component digest из dependency set или authority epoch.
requirements.FitCriterion: CAS test с изменённым dependency HEAD отклоняет crossing и не меняет контекст.

requirements.Statement: Core может предоставлять неавторизующую симуляцию только как отдельный артефакт, который невозможно предъявить гейту.
requirements.FitCriterion: Simulation schema не проходит Permit/crossing validation.

requirements.Statement: Core должен изолировать authority, policy, Permit ledger и scoped context HEADs по tenant и normative domain.
requirements.FitCriterion: Cross-tenant/domain references отклоняются во всех API и storage constraints.

requirements.Statement: Master должен формировать PlanProposal из Goal и подписанного ContextProjection, сохраняя альтернативы и основания выбора.
requirements.FitCriterion: PlanProposal содержит source context root, goal, alternatives и provenance.

requirements.Statement: Master должен формировать и подписывать ExpectedChangePatch, явно маркированный EXPECTED и не являющийся фактом.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema и prompt test не допускают отображение EXPECTED в verified-facts section.

requirements.Statement: ExpectedChangePatch должен содержать source context dependencies, expected claims, preserved invariants и acceptance intent.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema rejects missing required semantic field; examples validate.

requirements.Statement: Master должен ранжировать PlanProposal как RECOMMENDED, RISKY, DISCOURAGED или UNKNOWN без создания authority.
requirements.FitCriterion: Assessment не содержит Permit и не принимается GateKernel как authority artifact.

requirements.Statement: Master должен отдельно оценивать порядок шагов, достижимость цели, риски траектории и необходимость replanning.
requirements.FitCriterion: TrajectoryAssessment содержит отдельные поля и тесты конфликтных случаев.

requirements.Statement: Каждое аналитическое утверждение Master должно содержать evidence level, uncertainty и provenance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema/review обнаруживает ноль безуровневых статистических claims.

requirements.Statement: Master должен поддерживать versioned planning, critic, selector и replanning profiles.
requirements.FitCriterion: Воспроизведение с теми же inputs/profile возвращает тот же structured result для deterministic profile.

requirements.Statement: Master должен учитывать recommendation exposure и selection bias и не обучаться на непроверенном Worker self-report как на успехе.
requirements.FitCriterion: LearningObservation rejects outcome without AcceptanceDecision and epistemic status.

requirements.Statement: Master должен разделять expected, observed, verified, accepted и delayed outcome labels.
requirements.FitCriterion: Confusion-matrix tests для enum/state transitions проходят без запрещённых повышений.

requirements.Statement: Master должен вычислять cost, duration, rework и effect metrics только по связанным LearningObservation с evidence strength.
requirements.FitCriterion: Metric lineage содержит input receipts и исключает неподтверждённые rows.

requirements.Statement: Cross-tenant analytics Master должны быть запрещены по умолчанию и включаться только явным privacy-preserving profile и Permit.
requirements.FitCriterion: Default configuration возвращает no data; allowed profile имеет отдельный Permit trail.

requirements.Statement: Master не должен иметь write-доступа к Core, Memory и Monade stores и не должен исполнять ExternalEffect.
requirements.FitCriterion: Deployment/IAM tests подтверждают отсутствие write credentials и tool dispatch API.

requirements.Statement: Monade должна создавать Task с Goal, accountable owner, CompletionContract и начальным composite context scope.
requirements.FitCriterion: Task creation schema и invariant tests подтверждают все mandatory fields.

requirements.Statement: Monade должна владеть PlanRevision и TransitionGraph, но не ExpectedChangePatch Master и не Permit Core.
requirements.FitCriterion: Ownership checks исключают запись чужих artifact types.

requirements.Statement: Monade должна состоять из независимых Execution и Acceptance компонентов с раздельными identities и stores не ниже Standard profile.
requirements.FitCriterion: Deployment manifest и access tests подтверждают separation; Compact profile сохраняет логические boundaries.

requirements.Statement: Monade Execution должна принимать подписанный ExpectedChangePatch только после успешного Expectation Admission Gate.
requirements.FitCriterion: ExpectedChange без crossing receipt не попадает в execution projection.

requirements.Statement: Monade Execution должна формировать OperationalBinding без изменения semantic target, expected claims и preserved invariants Master.
requirements.FitCriterion: Mutation tests каждого защищённого поля требуют нового ExpectedChangePatch.

requirements.Statement: Monade Execution должна формировать отдельный ExecutionDispatchSubmission для конкретных actor, tool, target, operation, parameters, effect profile и reconciliation method.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema validates all fields; wildcard target and missing reconciliation fail for mutating effect.

requirements.Statement: Prompt Compiler должен создавать PromptManifest из разрешённой context projection и не выдавать модели неразрешённые components.
requirements.FitCriterion: Claim-reference and classification tests подтверждают exact projection.

requirements.Statement: Dispatch Gate должен атомарно добавить ExecutionIntent и OutboxCommand в новый context и consume ExecutionPermit; внешний эффект выполняется позже dispatcher.
requirements.FitCriterion: Fault injection показывает all-or-none для context artifacts; external call отсутствует внутри gate transaction.

requirements.Statement: ExecutionObservation должна добавляться отдельным idempotent Observation Gate и иметь статус OBSERVED/UNVERIFIED.
requirements.FitCriterion: Duplicate observation ID создаёт один patch; статус не повышается автоматически.

requirements.Statement: Monade Acceptance должна собирать независимый EvidenceBundle и применять versioned VerificationProfile и AcceptanceContract.
requirements.FitCriterion: AcceptanceDecision содержит evidence/profile/contract digests и claim results.

requirements.Statement: Monade Acceptance должна различать VERIFIED_SUCCESS, VERIFIED_FAILURE, NO_EFFECT, PARTIAL_EFFECT и EFFECT_UNKNOWN отдельно от normative compliance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema/state tests покрывают Cartesian cases operational×normative.

requirements.Statement: Execution не должна создавать AcceptanceDecision; Acceptance не должна выполнять primary external effect.
requirements.FitCriterion: IAM and API tests запрещают обе cross-boundary operations.

requirements.Statement: Retry, verification probe и compensation должны использовать новые documents, gates, execution IDs и one-shot Permits.
requirements.FitCriterion: Attempt to reuse previous Permit or crossing receipt is rejected.

requirements.Statement: После failure, changed context или rejected acceptance Monade должна запросить новый PlanProposal/ExpectedChangePatch, если изменяется смысл цели.
requirements.FitCriterion: State machine blocks worker improvisation and records replan request.

requirements.Statement: Monade должна устанавливать Task completion только через отдельный TaskCompletion Gate после TaskAcceptance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Completion without accepted claims/contract is impossible in state model.

requirements.Statement: Human approval, appeal, override и cancellation должны быть оформлены подписанными documents и проходить соответствующий Core gate.
requirements.FitCriterion: UI/API actions without valid signed document produce no Permit.

requirements.Statement: Monade должна раскрывать current context root, blocking gate, missing evidence, last resolution и next allowed document type.
requirements.FitCriterion: Status API contract contains all fields for every nonterminal state.

requirements.Statement: Monade должна применять только degraded behavior, явно разрешённый conformance profile; отсутствие Core или Acceptance блокирует соответствующий переход.
requirements.FitCriterion: Failure tests: Core unavailable→no crossing; Acceptance unavailable→no accepted outcome.

requirements.Statement: Worker Runtime должен связываться ровно с одним WorkerEnvelope, execution_id и Dispatch GateCrossingReceipt.
requirements.FitCriterion: Envelope reuse for another execution/crossing is rejected.

requirements.Statement: Worker Runtime должен видеть только инструменты, операции, target и limits точного OperationalBinding.
requirements.FitCriterion: Capability sandbox rejects every out-of-envelope operation.

requirements.Statement: Worker Runtime не должен изменять ExpectedChangePatch, PlanRevision, Permit, PromptManifest или AcceptanceContract.
requirements.FitCriterion: Readonly mount/API and mutation tests deny all protected artifacts.

requirements.Statement: Worker Runtime должен возвращать ExecutionObservation и artifacts, а не verified outcome или AcceptanceDecision.
requirements.FitCriterion: Output schema excludes acceptance fields and self-verdict is ignored.

requirements.Statement: Ephemeral Worker identity и credentials должны отзываться после reported, failed, expired или cancelled state.
requirements.FitCriterion: Post-terminal authentication attempts fail.

requirements.Statement: Worker Runtime должен соблюдать operation count, time, resource, token и cost limits OperationalBinding.
requirements.FitCriterion: Boundary tests terminate at exact limits and emit observation.

requirements.Statement: Human execution adapter должен сохранять те же envelope, Permit, crossing, observation и evidence semantics.
requirements.FitCriterion: Human path produces protocol-equivalent artifacts and cannot self-accept.

requirements.Statement: Verifier Registry в Monade Acceptance должен применять versioned VerificationProfile к явному claim set и evidence requirements.
requirements.FitCriterion: VerificationReceipt binds exact claim/profile/evidence digests.

requirements.Statement: VerificationVerdict должен различать PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN, INCONCLUSIVE и CONFLICTING на уровне claims.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema and aggregation tests cover all verdicts.

requirements.Statement: Worker self-report не должен быть достаточным evidence, если profile явно не маркирует его как non-authoritative input.
requirements.FitCriterion: Negative test with only self-report cannot yield ACCEPTED.

requirements.Statement: VerificationReceipt должен связывать task, expected change, execution, claims, evidence, profile и verifier identity.
requirements.FitCriterion: Missing any binding fails schema and acceptance.

requirements.Statement: Повторная верификация должна создавать новый receipt и не перезаписывать прежний verdict.
requirements.FitCriterion: History contains both receipts and supersession relation.

requirements.Statement: UNKNOWN/INCONCLUSIVE/CONFLICTING должны приводить к evidence request, wait, human review или explicit unknown outcome, но не к success.
requirements.FitCriterion: State transition tests contain no path to ACCEPTED without policy-sufficient evidence.

requirements.Statement: Acceptance verification probes должны иметь отдельный document, gate and Permit и минимальный evidence scope.
requirements.FitCriterion: Probe without Permit or outside scope is denied.

requirements.Statement: Verifier profiles/adapters должны иметь stable ID/version, conformance status и trust tier.
requirements.FitCriterion: Registry rejects unregistered or nonconformant adapter in managed profile.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall accept provider-neutral CanonicalInferenceRequest linked to task/transition/context receipt.
requirements.FitCriterion: Two provider adapters receive semantically equivalent canonical input.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall own provider-specific chat template, tool schema rendering and tokenizer profile.
requirements.FitCriterion: Provider adapter tests show no provider formatting in Memory/Monade records.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall treat provider conversation IDs as disposable cache references.
requirements.FitCriterion: Deleting provider state does not prevent task reconstruction from ASET receipts.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall normalize provider tool/function calls into ToolCallProposal without executing them.
requirements.FitCriterion: Adapter test produces proposal event and zero tool invocation.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall produce usage receipt containing model, provider, latency, tokens/units, cost if known and cache use.
requirements.FitCriterion: 100% completed inference calls have receipt or explicit unavailable fields.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall distinguish ephemeral deltas from durable semantic events.
requirements.FitCriterion: Token deltas are not written as MemoryItems; completed proposal/result events are persisted.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall enforce provider/data policy before transmitting content.
requirements.FitCriterion: Disallowed provider/classification pair sends zero request bytes and returns policy receipt.

requirements.Statement: Gateway shall verify rendered prompt/tool budget against model profile before invocation.
requirements.FitCriterion: Oversized request is repacked or rejected according to profile; provider is never called with known overflow.

requirements.Statement: Каждый normative artifact должен использовать versioned canonical envelope с tenant, issuer, subject refs, correlation и integrity metadata.
requirements.FitCriterion: All published schemas reject missing envelope fields.

requirements.Statement: Protocol должен определить compatibility и negotiation для каждой schema и запретить silent semantic fallback.
requirements.FitCriterion: Compatibility matrix tests reject unsupported major version.

requirements.Statement: Receipts должны содержать stable ID, issuer, subject/digest refs, schema version, timestamp source, status и signature metadata.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema validates complete receipt and rejects mutable aliases.

requirements.Statement: Strict profile должен проверять signatures, issuer authority for artifact type, key status и revocation epoch.
requirements.FitCriterion: Expired/revoked/wrong-type signatures fail verification.

requirements.Statement: Canonical JSON profile ASET-JCS-1 и SHA-256 digest должны быть обязательны для baseline conformance.
requirements.FitCriterion: Python and JavaScript reference vectors produce identical ASET-JCS-1 bytes for safe integer boundaries and UTF-8 key-order edge cases; duplicate raw names, NFC collisions, floats and unsafe integers are rejected.

requirements.Statement: Binary profiles могут применяться только при доказанной semantic equivalence с canonical JSON vectors.
requirements.FitCriterion: Round-trip suite preserves every normative field and digest meaning.

requirements.Statement: Protocol должен сохранять context, document, gate, permit, crossing, task, execution, evidence and acceptance correlation IDs.
requirements.FitCriterion: Every positive Permit resolves to exactly one signed CoreResolution binding the exact Submission and Permit digest; no unresolved authority edge is accepted.

requirements.Statement: Protocol должен различать document, expected claim, observation, evidence, resolution, Permit, receipt and outcome by schema.
requirements.FitCriterion: Cross-type substitution attacks are rejected.

requirements.Statement: Protocol должен публиковать machine-readable conformance profile manifests и mandatory schema/invariant IDs.
requirements.FitCriterion: Profile manifest validation and coverage report pass.

requirements.Statement: Retryable protocol operations должны иметь idempotency key и stable duplicate response semantics.
requirements.FitCriterion: Duplicate tests return same resource/result and create no duplicate state.

requirements.Statement: Envelope должен нести classification, purpose and allowed-use metadata для content-bearing artifacts.
requirements.FitCriterion: Policy test blocks mismatched purpose/classification.

requirements.Statement: Default telemetry должна содержать IDs, digests, timings and measurements без prompt/content.
requirements.FitCriterion: Telemetry scan finds no classified content in default profile.

requirements.Statement: Контекст должен быть CompositeContextManifest неизменяемых SignedContextComponent с каноническим Merkle root.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema и Merkle vectors воспроизводят root; mutation test изменяет root.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-002 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Каждый context component должен подписываться только его зарегистрированным semantic owner.
requirements.FitCriterion: Wrong-owner signature rejected for every component type.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-002 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Подпись component должна означать происхождение и целостность, но не truth, currentness или Permit.
requirements.FitCriterion: Conformance tests reject signature as authority or epistemic promotion.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-002 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Existing Context и components не должны изменяться; новый gate создаёт новые versions и root.
requirements.FitCriterion: Content-addressed objects remain byte-identical after 100 transitions.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-002 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Permit должен содержать exact read_set/write_set component digests.
requirements.FitCriterion: Schema and CAS test reject missing or stale dependency.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Cross-component patch set должен применяться полностью либо не применяться вовсе.
requirements.FitCriterion: Fault injection over every write produces only all-before or all-after.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Composite root должен использовать канонический порядок component type/id/version/digest/issuer.
requirements.FitCriterion: Permutation vectors produce identical root using the exact order component_type,component_id,version,digest,owner_id,owner_key_id; owner_key_id-only changes change the root.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-006 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Memory и operational Context должны иметь разные schemas, stores and ownership.
requirements.FitCriterion: No Context write API can mutate MemoryItem and vice versa.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-002 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Каждый consumer должен получать минимальную role/purpose-scoped ContextProjection.
requirements.FitCriterion: Projection tests contain no forbidden claims/classification.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-002 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Изменение component вне dependency set не должно само по себе инвалидировать Permit.
requirements.FitCriterion: Parallel independent transition succeeds while dependent change fails.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Каждый target context должен ссылаться на source root, patch set digest и crossing receipt.
requirements.FitCriterion: Graph traversal reconstructs every root to genesis.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-004 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Удаление/retention content должно сохранять проверяемые cryptographic tombstones без раскрытия удалённого содержания.
requirements.FitCriterion: Deletion test removes content and retains non-reconstructive lineage proof.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-013, SYS-014 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Context storage должен поддерживать snapshots/compaction без изменения normative history roots.
requirements.FitCriterion: Pre/post compaction inclusion proofs and roots are identical.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-014, SYS-017 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Canonical, speculative и analytical context branches должны быть явно различимы; merge является отдельным gate.
requirements.FitCriterion: Speculative root cannot be used as canonical source without merge receipt.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-019 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Expected, observed, verified and accepted claims должны храниться разными typed artifacts/statuses.
requirements.FitCriterion: Forbidden state promotions are rejected by schema/state model.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-002 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Каждый gate crossing должен требовать точный OneShotPermit соответствующего gate type.
requirements.FitCriterion: Cross-gate Permit substitution rejected.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-003 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Permit должен допускать maximum_crossings=1 и immediate consume window, определяемое policy.
requirements.FitCriterion: Second, late, expired-at-issuance and lifetime>60s crossing is rejected.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-003 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Gate должен быть единственной linearization point канонического context transition.
requirements.FitCriterion: History contains no canonical root change outside gate ledger.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Повтор одного crossing_id должен возвращать тот же target root и receipt.
requirements.FitCriterion: Concurrent duplicate test returns one result.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: ExpectationPermit и ExecutionPermit должны иметь несовместимые schema/gate bindings.
requirements.FitCriterion: ExpectationPermit at Dispatch Gate is rejected.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-022, SYS-003 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Expectation Admission Gate должен добавлять только AUTHORIZED_EXPECTED patch и не создавать external effect intent.
requirements.FitCriterion: Resulting context contains no tool/outbox artifact.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-022, SYS-003 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Dispatch Gate должен требовать accepted ExpectedChange reference и exact OperationalBinding.
requirements.FitCriterion: Missing/stale expectation or binding denied.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-022, SYS-003 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Dispatch Gate должен атомарно создать ExecutionIntent и OutboxCommand, но не вызывать external connector внутри gate transaction.
requirements.FitCriterion: Instrumentation observes zero external calls in transaction.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-022, SYS-003 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Revocation before linearization must block crossing; revocation after crossing must not erase historical receipt.
requirements.FitCriterion: Boundary race tests follow ordering.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Stale source dependency set must leave Permit unconsumed or terminally invalid without applying patch.
requirements.FitCriterion: CAS mismatch produces no target root.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: GateCrossingReceipt должен bind permit, source/target roots, gate, crossing, patch set and consumed_at.
requirements.FitCriterion: Receipt schema and lineage check pass.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-004 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Protocol error, unavailable Core or unverifiable evidence must yield no Permit and no crossing.
requirements.FitCriterion: Chaos/fuzz tests produce zero crossings.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-020, SYS-003 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Retry must use RetrySubmission, new execution/crossing IDs and RetryPermit with prior effect evidence.
requirements.FitCriterion: Old Permit reuse and absent effect evidence rejected.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-022, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Compensation must be a new ExpectedChange/OperationalBinding and separate CompensationPermit unless predeclared bounded contingency applies.
requirements.FitCriterion: Compensation without new gate trail rejected.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-022, SYS-008 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Acceptance and TaskCompletion must be separate gates from execution and must not retroactively authorize an effect.
requirements.FitCriterion: Accepted technical result without execution compliance remains NON_COMPLIANT.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-023, SYS-020 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Prompt Compiler должен детерминированно компилировать ContextProjection, profile и model capability в PromptManifest.
requirements.FitCriterion: Same inputs/version yield byte-identical PromptManifest.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-005 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: PromptManifest должен сохранять разделы verified facts, assumptions, authorized expected, constraints, forbidden actions и unknowns.
requirements.FitCriterion: Golden prompts keep every claim in correct section.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-005 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Каждый prompt section должен ссылаться на source claim IDs и source context root.
requirements.FitCriterion: 100% prompt statements have lineage refs.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-005 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Prompt Compiler должен применять deterministic token/item/classification budget and compaction profile.
requirements.FitCriterion: Repeated packing yields same selected claims and budget result.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-014, SYS-017 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Prompt Compiler не должен вызывать LLM, tool или повышать epistemic status.
requirements.FitCriterion: IAM/static tests show no provider/tool/acceptance dependencies.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-005 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Model Gateway должен provider-render PromptManifest без semantic changes и вернуть rendered request digest.
requirements.FitCriterion: Cross-provider semantic equivalence vectors pass.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-005 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Provider conversation/cache/streaming deltas не должны становиться canonical Context без отдельного admission gate.
requirements.FitCriterion: Provider state injection test creates no context patch.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-021, SYS-005 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: PromptManifest должен bind compiler version, projection profile, model profile, source root и prompt digest.
requirements.FitCriterion: Replay reconstructs identical provider-neutral prompt.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-004 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Пакет должен содержать normative JSON и YAML system model с modules, ownership, artifacts, gates, invariants and state machines.
requirements.FitCriterion: Strict raw JSON parsing, JSON Schema validation, complete identity lint and JSON/YAML canonical-digest parity all pass.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Пакет должен содержать machine-readable interface/gate/conformance specification linked to model digest.
requirements.FitCriterion: Specification validates and model_digest matches model.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Все normative cross-module artifacts должны иметь JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 и валидные examples.
requirements.FitCriterion: Validator passes all examples and rejects mutation corpus.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Diagrams, model registry and coverage reports должны генерироваться из stable IDs machine model.
requirements.FitCriterion: Regeneration yields zero orphan IDs and deterministic manifests.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Каждое requirement должно ссылаться на существующие Need, ADR, model elements and verification case.
requirements.FitCriterion: Automated referential integrity reports zero errors.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Build должен отклонять normative prose containing superseded semantics as active requirements.
requirements.FitCriterion: Forbidden-semantic rules detect legacy ALLOW decisions, legacy permit-consumption entities and top-level Planner/Verifier/Worker ownership.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Conformance manifest должен перечислять mandatory schemas, gates, invariants and profiles.
requirements.FitCriterion: Coverage report is 100% for mandatory IDs.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-019 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Build and validation tools должны использовать только package-relative paths и работать clean-room.
requirements.FitCriterion: Package copied to new path passes all validators.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Normative machine artifacts, documents and package manifest должны иметь SHA-256 checksums.
requirements.FitCriterion: The archive has exact manifest/checksum scope, no undeclared/cache member, and final validation reruns rather than trusts cached conformance evidence.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Package validation must distinguish documentation/schema conformance from unexecuted implementation/production conformance.
requirements.FitCriterion: All dual representations and validation evidence have exact parity and a single honest pre-independent-audit status.
requirements.Rationale: Derived from NEED-019, SYS-018 and rc2 architecture.

requirements.Statement: Critical module state changes shall be append-only or versioned and recoverable from receipts/events.
requirements.FitCriterion: Recovery test reconstructs equivalent state from approved snapshot plus events.

requirements.Statement: Service identities shall use least privilege and no module shall have direct write privilege to another module store.
requirements.FitCriterion: Privilege audit finds zero cross-owner direct writes.

requirements.Statement: Reference profile shall publish measured latency/throughput targets only after baseline benchmarking and mark them profile-specific.
requirements.FitCriterion: No unmeasured numeric target is normative; benchmark report supplies every promoted target.

requirements.Statement: Human-facing web interfaces shall target WCAG 2.2 AA or an approved equivalent.
requirements.FitCriterion: Accessibility audit has zero critical violations and documented exceptions.

requirements.Statement: Requester, approver, policy owner, auditor and operator workflows shall have role-specific acceptance scenarios.
requirements.FitCriterion: Each role completes ≥90% critical scenarios without developer assistance.

requirements.Statement: All requirements, models, ADRs and verification cases shall use stable IDs and controlled change workflow.
requirements.FitCriterion: A cross-package identity lint rejects duplicate primary IDs and key IDs in every normative registry.

requirements.Statement: Each module shall publish contract tests and reference vectors independent of internal implementation.
requirements.FitCriterion: Alternative adapter passes suite without linking reference implementation internals.

requirements.Statement: Deployment descriptors shall separate canonical contracts from platform-specific infrastructure.
requirements.FitCriterion: Two deployment profiles use same protocol/requirements baseline.

requirements.Statement: Audit retention and data-subject erasure conflicts shall be resolved by explicit policy and minimal tombstone.
requirements.FitCriterion: Policy matrix test records lawful resolution and no hidden retained content.

requirements.Statement: Documentation release shall build from a clean checkout through one documented command.
requirements.FitCriterion: Clean-room release regenerates all derived representations, reruns full conformance and reproduces stable artifacts without trusting stored PASS reports.
